Quality Without Compromise

Our Story

With deep roots in our community, we have built a legacy of craftsmanship and integrity that has withstood the test of time. Learn more about our path to becoming Ithaca’s leading remodeling company.

ROOTED & LOCAL
Our story begins in Ithaca.

Upscale Remodeling has been serving our Ithaca community for more than 30 years, but our roots in the area go back centuries. The ancestors of our founder, Steve Nash, settled the Ellis Hollow/Snyder Hill area in the early 1800s and built some of the region’s first homes.

Steve learned building by working with his father and grandfather from the age of nine. More importantly, he learned to never compromise and never cut corners. These values still guide us to this day, ensuring that every project is not merely a job but a testament to our commitment to excellence.

MEET OUR FOUNDER
Steve Nash

Growing up in Ithaca and coming from a long line of builders, craftsmanship is in my DNA. Dating back to the 1700s, my family has constructed homes in the Ithaca area that have stood the test of time—homes that are still standing today.

At Upscale Remodeling, we’re not just remodeling homes; we’re building a legacy. We refuse to compromise on quality because our roots in this community run deep, and we plan to remain here for many generations to come. Our tradition of craftsmanship drives our commitment to timeless design and durable construction. We are proud of our work, and we want our clients to be able to enjoy it for many years to come.

Our commitment to excellence isn’t just a catchphrase—it’s who we are, what our company stands for. As we continue this proud tradition of building and remodeling, our focus remains fixed on delivering enduring quality to you and your family.

The Design Build Remodel Process

We’ve put a lot of care into developing and refining our design-build process, and we think it leads to great results. When there are clear expectations in place, delays, budget overruns, miscommunications, and missed deadlines are significantly reduced.

What Is Design Build?

The design build method is a construction delivery approach that stands apart from the traditional method, where the homeowner hires a separate architect or designer and then a general contractor. Instead, a design build firm offers architectural design and construction services, all under one roof.

 

Unlike the traditional competitive bidding process, which can lead to inaccurate initial estimates as contractors compete against one another, the design build remodel method eliminates such pressures. It offers a more realistic and collaborative approach to project pricing, ensuring clear communication and a more efficient design process. Homeowners gain a true understanding of their budget and feel confident about pricing before committing to a construction contract. The result is a streamlined remodeling project delivery and greater collaboration between the homeowner and the design-build team. For a major project, like a master bathroom or kitchen remodel, the design build remodel approach can offer the smoothest, most efficient experience for the homeowner.

REVIEWS

People Have Nice Things to Say

We are the Ithaca remodelers with a perfect 5-star average on Google, Houzz, GuildQuality, and Facebook, plus hundreds of testimonials from happy clients, highlighting the exceptional experiences they’ve had working with us.

We felt like we were working with friends rather than a company.

Sharon S. & Girish B.

Very professional company. . . . We were pleased with the outcome and amazed by how fast they finished the project. They have stood by their work and have come over to adjust cabinets and fix little problems without any hesitation. Highly recommended!

Randall Corey

Town of Ithaca

Thank you for the competent preparation and work you and your crew did on the painting of the interior of our house. We especially appreciate all of the advice and careful handling of the furniture during the work. We had little cleanup as you people did most of it.

Enid R.

Thanks for the professional help in our remodeling needs! I appreciate the extra effort of the siding, we definitely got in a little over our heads with all that was needed to make this space livable. Between the very professional work done by Rich and Pete, and all that PJ and I ended up doing, my mother was very pleased and is comfortable in her new home.

Scott Z.

We decided to use Upscale for our kitchen remodel because we had such a great customer service experience with Val in their design center from the first day we entered their store. She was extremely helpful and experienced and she guided us through our project from start to finish. I highly recommend this company for your home remodeling needs.

Betty Dean

AJ and Peter did an excellent with the project that I needed done. They explained what they were doing and why, and answered all of my questions. They took pride in their work, as evidenced by the care and thought for each project. I felt very comfortable with them working in and around my home.

Cheryl G.

If you are planning a high-quality renovation project, definitely contact Upscale Remodeling because it lives up to its name.

Anita R.

My explanation of the project was considered and many suggestions for what to use were given. New materials are good quality as is the workmanship. All craftsmen were very easy and pleasant to work with.

Barbara D.

Thank you for a job well done. I am happy with the results and will look forward to more projects together.

Mary C.

Their workers are experts, professional, thoughtful and remarkably neat. We will never hire another contractor.

Eleanor Dozier

Newfield

If you want a quality job at a fair price, we can't think of a single reason not to hire Upscale Remodeling. We highly recommend Upscale to everyone - with no hesitation.

Alan & Jude Wood

We are STILL enjoying the oak flooring in our living and dining rooms, as well as the more air-tight house provided by new windows, doors and door sealing. Thanks so much for a job well done! And happy New Year!

Alice C.

Everyone we worked with at Upscale showed a high degree of professionalism and consideration. . . . We are pleased to enthusiastically recommend Upscale Remodeling for the manner in which the work was executed and for the excellence of the final results.

Roger and Debbie L

Asbury

I really appreciated the fact that when you saw that the first set of windows were not properly fitted you immediately set out to rectify the matter.

Judith M.

Bud and I are so very pleased with the quality and results of the work that has been done thus far on 105 Miller St. Thank you so very much for your efforts and assistance regarding insurance matters.

Anne & Bud H.

Just a small gift in appreciation for your dedication to our bath remodel and being our guest these past few weeks. We are thrilled with the results. Wishing you and Upscale Corp good luck through this business turn down, and will be seeking you out if further remodeling is needed.

Roger & Ella B.

Thanks so much, Steve. We look forward to more of your great work on our house!

Karen C.

Another job well done!

Tori W.

I choose Upscale Remodeling in NY anytime the job is extensive, because I know that Upscale is reliable and does the best quality work. I would advise anyone Upscale to use them: the service, workmanship, reliability, and professionalism that upscale provides exceeds all others in our area.

Jess C., Delta Gamma

Just checking to wish you and your family a happy holiday and thank you for the lovely Poinsettia. I also wanted to note that your crew is first-rate and a very helpful and nice group of guys. Brian and Pete are very skilled and Steve Bossard has been quite helpful to us from day one.

Marjorie P.

Upscale was completely professional and provided excellent work. . . . If you are interested in the best quality workmanship, excellent communication, and friendly, professional employees, you should choose Upscale Remodeling for your next project.

Jess Cisco

Cornell Heights Historic District

We are delighted with the work. We can certainly feel the effects of the decreased heat loss through the new windows. For the first time in the 16 years we've lived here, the furnace keeps the room comfortable when it's in the 20s outside. Once again, we thank Rich and Pete for making this as painless as possible for us. You can certainly add us to your long list of satisfied customers.

Roger & Deborah L.

We were amazed at the quality of the workmanship and refusal to cut corners. If you want a quality job at a fair price, we can't think of a single reason not to hire Upscale Remodeling. We highly recommend Upscale to everyone - with no hesitation.

Alan Wood

Southwest Ithaca

Thank you Steve Nash and Upscale Remodeling. I could not have done it without you.

Sally Dullea

West Hill

Many thanks to the entire Upscale team for providing us with a beautiful and functional addition to our home.

Bob S. & Karen H.

Your attention to detail really makes a big difference in the final results, and we appreciate the care and expertise of your full crew! Please tell them for us.

Anita & Bob R.

I am quite pleased with what Rich is doing! Thank you!

Ruth L.

Upscale was able to rebuild my house in just a little over 6 months which included the month-long demolition! I absolutely would (will & have) recommend Upscale Remodeling in NY to anyone who wants the best work & materials possible & will use them again if needed.

Celia E., M.D.

All employees are very pleasant to have around. We have especially enjoyed having Dan work on our project. He is very helpful in pointing out things we may have overlooked when planning the project.

Dolores S.

We have been very pleased with the quality of workmanship, honesty and trustworthiness of Upscale Remodeling in NY. Their excellent renovations have added substantial value to our home.

Ray & Margaret V.

We’ve been extremely satisfied with the work done by Upscale in several different projects. . . . We certainly would recommend Upscale for any level of renovation work.

Jeff R.

A couple of days ago, your magnificent poinsettia arrived to grace the equally magnificent work done by you on this house – the months you spent demolishing and rebuilding the entire inside of it being more demanding and requiring as much care as building an entire house from scratch. Now it once again provides a setting appropriate to a Christmas poinsettia.

Celia E.

Very easy to work with, top quality work, very responsive (especially by email, which is easiest for me). My only complaint is that it took about 6 months before the project got started. It was completed very promptly once it started.

Rob J.

We cannot get over the workmanship of Rich! He was a pleasure to have around, so patient and incredible how clean he left things at the end of the day! You are lucky to have him and I hope we will have him and you on another project.”

Nancy & Bill F.

The cabinets look amazing – even better than before! You are an incredible craftsman and carpenter… a true artist. The cabinets now look like they did before the fire. Thank you very, very much.

Celia E.

We wanted to write to say how happy we are with Rich’s work on the crawl space. Carol tells me that it was a horrible job, but it looks wonderful now – well sealed and tidy. We’ve been having problems with musty smells for years. I feel foolish not having addressed them earlier (but extremely happy to have had Rich to shoulder the burden for me).

Jim S.

Thank you so much for your prompt response to our ice/roof/leakage problem – the guys you sent were terrific!

Ruana W.

We absolutely couldn’t be happier. . . . If you are looking for a truly honest contractor we highly recommend Upscale Remodeling. . . . We will definitely recommend Upscale Remodeling to anyone who asks us. We plan to use Upscale for other remodeling projects.

Victoria Wishart

Northeast Ithaca

We really LOVE our new kitchen remodel! All the workers are great too. As are you!

Greta C.

We cannot thank you and your team enough for making our home remodeling experience so great. . . . The construction process was a fantastic experience.

Dan & Debbie G.

Upscale’s work was superb. . . . Steve and his carpenters take great pride in their work, and we know that future owners of this house will enjoy and be as grateful for the quality of Upscale’s work as we are now.

Hayden Letchworth

West Hill

We are very pleased with the work the upscale crew did on our house involving window replacement and reconfiguration, and fine kitchen cabinetry. All of the people involved were excellent craftsmen who were also very personable, polite and respectful of our space and time.

Deborah S.

The porch looks beautiful. We have gotten a lot of compliments on it.

Tori & John W

Workers are pleasant to have around-always a professional job. I wouldn’t consider having any other company.

Mary M.

The cabinet is beautiful! Thank you very much! Everyone who has seen it has commented favorably upon your work. Your contribution to the library is a generous gift, and we count you as a true Friend of the Library.

Janet Steiner, Director of The Tompkins County Public Library

I love my new kitchen remodel! And, I will call upon my return next spring so that you can see the transformation! Have a healthy, happy, and prosperous 2008.

Doris R.

Many thanks for your help at the Science Center build on May 12. Despite the rain, we got everything accomplished – and then some!

Charlie T. – Executive Director of The Science Center

Upscale has done for us several jobs of varying degrees of difficulty, and we are delighted that they are on our calendar for more work ahead. These are professionals who work patiently to figure out all of the complexities of the job at hand before undertaking it, and once they get started, the work is handled efficiently and neatly.

Eleanor D

Very knowledgeable, professional, able to answer all your questions and concerns. Skilled and extremely friendly and polite. Rich made some great recommendations for the master suite and the closet that made them turn out much better than I expected. I love my closet!

Mark & Mickie J.

Dan was very proactive in working with us-had a real feeling of ownership of how the project went, and kept us well informed; Great guy!”

Betsy M.

It is hard to believe that over a year has gone by since our renovation. We're enjoying the changes so much, thanks to your talented team. Thank you!

Anita & Bob R.

Several years ago they miraculously turned a horrible junky storage room into a spectacular library. It makes me happy just to walk into this room. We have a carpenter friend in Rochester who builds things in his own home and he keeps telling us that the quality of the work in this library is really astonishing and he hopes that we appreciate that. We do!.

Peter & Libby H.

Eric and I would love to express our joy with the final presentation of our new kitchen. We could not be happier. It was truly a collaborative effort and we especially want to commend you all.

Eric & Laurie L.

Thanks for a job well done. We are enjoying the new space Upscale built for us. The professionalism and courtesy of you and your crew is greatly appreciated. Thanks again!

Dan & Monica P.

Steve Jones did the usual very fine work on the screen door. It was good to see him.

Enid R.

We engaged Upscale for a complete bathroom remodel in Ithaca - the workmanship was tops with high quality materials used. Upscale performed on time and within budget. The company did two other small jobs for us - again excellent. We are pleased and highly recommend Steve Nash and Upscale.

Fred & Gudrun R.

They said they wanted me “completely satisfied”—they mean it and I am! Upscale’s work is of the highest quality. The firm is consistent. Upscale now has done two different remodeling jobs for me I am enormously pleased with both.

Eric & Margaret R.

Thank you for making our renovation project an enjoyable process. Here is a house-warmer for your new abode!

Karen & John C.

When Upscale does the work, you can be sure it is done right.

Maurice & Shirlee S.

The quality of work by Upscale exceeded all expectations. From the design stage through demo and installation, the work was professional, timely and meticulous. This was a substantial renovation project with a very small window for completion. Truly an exceptional experience.

Anne Anderson

I just wanted to let you know that I visited the Geise’s last week and got to see their remodeling job. It was beautiful and flawless. Clearly they are very happy. Nice work!

Alice M. of Warren Real Estate

We just completed our third set of projects with Upscale. Their leadership and design staff are thorough and thoughtful in the planning and design phase. Each team was patient and accommodating while being very knowledgeable and completing quality work on our home!

Stacey Murphy

East Ithaca

The house is looking absolutely spectacular and both my mother and I are very pleased with the work and the pace at which it is going. Thank you very much for everything. You and your crew not only do extraordinary work but are also thoughtful, kind and have been very patient with us.

Celia B.

Word of mouth is a very powerful tool. I have told, and will continue to tell, friends, colleagues, neighbors, etc… of Upscale’s excellent work – a company worthy of its name!

Lisa & Paul W.

The Upscale folks turned our ugly, horrible storage room into a library that could easily be featured in Architectural Digest. Steve and those he hired were terrific, from the planning stage to the final inspection. The craftsmanship was superb and the craftsmen were wonderful people. We couldn’t have been more pleased. We are now ready to collaborate with them to remodel our kitchen!

Peter & Libby H.

When recently we decided that it was time to renovate a vintage guest bathroom, there was no  need to consider anyone besides Upscale. We were confident entrusting Upscale to see us  artfully and fairly through our biggest home project. . . . We can testify to the wonder and worth of Upscale . . .

Victoria Pifalo

Upscale did a marvelous job of upgrading and screening in the front porch on our 100-year old house, transforming it from a little-used area to a wonderful “room” where we spent most of the summer. The folks from Upscale did a wonderful job that has improved our lives and will see our home through its next 100 years.

Lawrence Gibbons

University Hill

It is hard to believe that over a year had gone by since our renovation. We’re enjoying the changes so much, thanks to your talented team.

Anita & Bob R.

I liked the fact that both EJ and Peter were no-nonsense professionals of the highest caliber. They were both knowledgeable and able to explain to a novice like me what they were doing. Dislike having to pay what they were worth.

Michael O.

The overall experience with the Company and employees was congenial, courteous, pleasant and knowledgeable.

Edna S.

The windows look great! Dan and Ryan did such careful, beautiful work, touching up and repairing as they went. Plus, Dan is able to do all this leaving no mess in his wake other than the necessary furniture moving.

Fran K.

Over the years, it's been a pleasure working with your business and all your employees--Steve, Rich, Pete and Dan. Have a wonderful holiday season.

Sorayya K.

Just a quick note to let you know that I am delighted with the nice job Pete did on the stairwell walls. Sometimes a house has the final say and you just have to "go with it". The trim he put up does the trick.

Debbie N.

I am extremely satisfied with Upscale Remodeling in Ithaca, NY. The bathroom remodel was carefully detailed and estimated before it was started. Everyone associated with Upscale treated both me and the remodeling job itself with the utmost care and attention.

Eric R.

Showed extra care and concern with my cats, did a great job at daily clean-up, high level of craftsmanship.

Linda C.

Steve did not exceed the budget we allocated for our project, and our renovation is even more beautiful than we imagined it would be!

Nicholas & Catherine Walker

Thank all of you for all your effort, determination and patience to get the job done. I done see how you could have done so much but I do thank you and highly recommend you for any project.

Mary T.

We are very happy with the work you did in the kitchen at our cottage. We drove over there yesterday and found nothing lacking. Thank you.

John A.

It's our pleasure to do business with you and your firm.

Bettina A.

We have been meaning to write and tell you how very pleased we are with our remodeled bathroom. It is absolutely perfect. It is hard to believe that a bathroom as small as ours could be made into what seems like a larger and roomier room.

John & Tori W.

Just a quick note to tell you that the work on the home thus far is beautiful! Thank You.

Abe B.

Very easy to work with, top quality work, very responsive (especially by email, which is easiest for me). My only complaint is that it took about 6 months before the project got started. It was completed very promptly once it started.

Rob J.

An excellent job! By far the best thing was that the work was done on time, I always was called back within a reasonable amount of time and everything that we discussed was done without delay.

Maja A.

Thanks again to all your great employees!! We just LOVE the kitchen remodel. Of course, I knew it would be perfect! Until next time!

Lisa W.

Very professional, courteous workers. We liked that the job was finished to our specifications and satisfaction, in a timely fashion.

Matt & Kristen B.

Thank you for your prompt service. I certainly will recommend you to our friends and other “snowbirds” that are looking for a remodeling contractor in the Tompkins County area. Again - Thanks!

Phyllis G.

I just want you to know how much I appreciate all the time and work you put into building me a great deck.

Kris

The results are truly transformative, and the new integrates exceptionally well with the old. We hope to be able to use them again for all our future building and remodeling projects.

Sharon Tennyson

Trumansburg

Liked the thorough approach to doing business, liked the knowledge brought to our discussions – the positive innovation/idea generation.

Eric & Laurie L.

We hired Upscale Remodeling to replace our upstairs windows with new energy-efficient Marvin windows. Steve Nash was great at helping us refine our ideas, and the crew was careful, considerate, and efficient.

Jim S. & Carol D.

The Miller’s house looks wonderful. It really “fits” with their home and doesn’t look pasted on… something you are so good at!

Anne W.

We liked the way you listened to what we wanted and then made it happen. When a problem was discovered that needed major fixing, you explained what was needed and did a great job in record time.

Margaret H.

The doors downstairs are beautiful and the work Pete did is really professional. We like the doors a lot.”

Enid R.

Serious professionals. Good communication on all aspects. Courteous and thorough.

Debra C.

I was out all afternoon when the guys installed the bookshelves, etc. from Bub’s shop. When I came home there was still light so I rushed upstairs to have a look. It quite literally took my breath away. It is sooooooo beautiful!!!!!!! Thank you, thank you, thank you!!!!:-)

Libby H.

There was absolutely no hard sell to upgrade to frivolous additions to the bathroom. He is truly a contractor who does listen to what his customers have to say.

Tori W.

Steve Nash is a young man with old-fashioned values. He is honest, hard-working, innovative, articulate, courteous and fair and takes great pride in his work.

Arthur & Enid R.

I liked how good your people were at communicating with me – (communications were frequent so I wasn’t left wondering what was going on, and I always got quick responses).

Ingrid Z.

Upscale was completely professional and the workmanship has been excellent. The employees are friendly, knowledgeable, punctual, and very neat.

Mary Arlin

Fall Creek

Thanks so much for the wonderful and prompt service. Pete and Steve were simply wonderful to deal with.

Alice M.

Every facet of your business is conducted with polish and professionalism. Your crew was prompt, courteous, talented and dedicated to their craft.

Brian & Mary Ann P.

On Friday, we mailed a check for the work done to date by Upscale. We found the bill to be most fair. We want you to know that we are extremely pleased with all that has been accomplished. Peter Brock is a superb craftsperson and an absolute pleasure to have in our home. Your firm is more than living up to its fine reputation!

Carl & Jean G.

Upscale Remodeling has replaced our windows, part last year and part this year. They do beautiful careful work with great attention to detail. Timing works out just as they say it will.

Fran K.

Thanks for everything. I look forward to future projects.

Justine K.

We are very grateful for all the terrific service from your crew this year in getting a few minor projects and issues taken care for us. It sure is a great feeling knowing that we can always count on Upscale Remodeling

Dan & Debbie G.

First of all, a formal thank you for the temporary sink. Our guests appreciated it (although we ourselves had become used to washing our hands with the tub faucet, our guests had not). When I told people you'd put in a temporary sink, they were surprised. When I told them you'd offered, on your own, to do so, without our having requested it, they were amazed. So, thanks again.

Barbara K.

I really liked that you set standards and keep to them and that you took the initiative to redo stairs instead of waiting for us to either ask it or for something to happen (such as warping) before fixing problem.

Kalay M.

Thanks for the fine job done at Delta Gamma.

Evelyn B.

Replaced a large window and fixed a long-time roof leak quickly, neatly and at a reasonable cost. Top notch workmanship.‎

Gerry and Marty O.

A heartfelt THANK YOU to you and your staff for your patient guidance during the entire project and for your professional dedication to detail; the skill and pride in Upscale’s work is obvious, and is sincerely appreciated.

Hayden L.

If you are interested in the best quality workmanship, excellent communication, and friendly, professional employees, you should choose Upscale Remodeling for your next project.

Jess Cisco, Delta Gamma Sorority

The Upscale workers are trustworthy and professional. They were enjoyable to have around. Steve Nash and Steve Bossard are always available to answer questions and address concerns. They are committed to making the project RIGHT by our standards and wishes.

Kristin B.

Upscale is the most professional and thorough general contractor I have ever worked with. I have used Upscale for hundreds of thousands of dollars of work on several properties. All of their work is top notch and their responsiveness and professionalism is unmatched. Can not recommend their team highly enough!!

Julie Johnson

We hired Upscale to take an unfinished room over our garage and finish it into office space and a guest bedroom. We very much enjoyed working with them, and we have been extremely pleased with the result. We would strongly recommend Upscale to anyone.

David & Ann W.

Wonderful job from starting design to finishing work. Complete professionals -- they were courteous, clean, and hard-working. We plan on hiring them again.

Cesr42

A million and one thanks for making our house look like a million! You guys are the best!

The Waldrops

It has been a pleasure to work with you and your craftsmen. Your commitment to the best quality of workmanship and materials is very evident in the finished product.

Mark & Rhonda B.

We cannot get over the workmanship of Rich! He was a pleasure to have around; so patient and incredible how he left things at the end of the day! You are lucky to have him and I hope we will have him and you on another project. Thanks again.

Bill & Nancy F.

It was a pleasure doing business with Upscale Remodeling in NY. Everything was handled in a very professional manner, from the estimate, to the carpentry, to the billing. We will highly recommend you to our friends. Thanks for a great experience!

Jim & Marcie F.

We are absolutely loving our addition, everyone who sees it thinks it is wonderful and those who knew our "before" house are amazed at the transformation…Your crew, Pete, Brian and Rich, were not only superb craftsmen but enjoyable to see every day…. After they finished the job, we kind of missed seeing them!

Alan & Jude W.

At Upscale Remodeling in NY, all personnel were dedicated to performing and completing the job to the customer’s satisfaction.

Roger B.

The entire crew is very skilled, knowledgeable, and helpful in every way. So far the results are outstanding and, since we are living on the lower level, we have the opportunity to watch the daily progress they are making.

Marjorie P.

It is rare in this day and age to have someone truly care about the customer and to stand behind the final product. Steve actually returns your phone calls and/or e-mails in a timely manner. Imagine that. I have heard so many horror stories when it comes to contractors.

Mary C.

They are an incredible set of people to work with. From the first step which was scoping out the job, through to the proposal to the detailed work and the cleanup and finish they were amazing. . . . There were no hiccups at all. . . . I felt they went beyond what I expected.

Clifford Martin

We are still thrilled with the work your guys did for us.

Anne & David W.

I want to say that you have indeed exceeded my expectations. Peter did a great job and was in constant communication with me via notes and phone. The house was left clean every day and the bathroom looks great! I just got in the bathroom to clean it all tonight. I will be sure to recommend your service to all my colleagues and friends.

Jarett P.

We are very pleased with your work. The porch looks great!

Marcie F.

The renovations were great. I couldn’t have been happier with the work and the guys who worked on the renovations. They kept us informed on all aspects of the project and kept everything neat and clean when they were done each day. I was able to come to them with vague ideas and they helped to turn those ideas into some great rooms. Thanks!

Mark & Mickey J.

We were so pleased with the fine job Upscale Remodeling in NY did for us. Our two different jobs included replacing all our storm windows and doing a series of smaller fixing up and repairing things around our home. They were prompt and courteous and the workmanship was excellent.

Alice M.

Steve Nash was very thorough and helpful. If you want quality workmanship, professional, punctual, and courteous workmen, choose Upscale Remodeling.

Miarlin

Historic District

I can recommend Upscale with no reservations. Steve and his crew have good design sense as well as technical skills, and have been willing to work with me to carry out my plans as well as making suggestions as to how my vision can be carried out.

Justine K.

We have used Upscale Remodeling for several projects. We absolutely love working with them. Every detail is taken care of. Everyone is a pleasure to deal with. We are busy planning are next project. Can't wait!

Rachel Phillipson

Enfield

I wanted to extend my sincere appreciation to your company for providing quality, timely service and fixing the footer drain problem at my home.

Nick A.

Like many folks, we have heard horror stories about renovation projects gone wrong, exceeding budgets and timeframes and falling short of the quality of work envisioned. We worked with Upscale Remodeling, so this is not our story.

Nicholas & Katherine W.

We are very pleased with the job you all did. I couldn’t be happier with the process and the way we were treated. Thanks for all the hard work.

Caitlin S.

Nice job communicating status and explaining issues/options.

Renell C.

We are very pleased with the new windows. The whole upstairs is now much quieter, an unexpected nice feature.

James S.

Throughout the process, we were impressed with the professionalism of all involved, the very obvious commitment to quality, the creative design assistance provided, and the high quality of the finished products. . . . Upscale is a top notch, professional organization producing fine results.

South Hill

Steve Nash and his amazing crew have always been exceedingly helpful, honest, and hard-working. They are absolutely dependable and we wouldn’t dream of working with anyone else.

Sorayya K.

YES… The room is WONDERFUL, and looking better every day! I couldn’t be happier with the ceiling, cabinets, paint color, lights, etc. Your workmen are great, too!

Anita R

What we liked most about working with Steve Nash and his crew is how carefully they managed the time and expenses of the project. We asked them to be really clear and upfront with us about the budget - that we didn't and couldn't go over. They were amazing about this. Right on target. Right on time. Honest, hard, and consistent work that came out great!

Nicholas Walker

University Hill

One of your previous customers who we called for a reference indicated we would be very lucky to have you do our project. After the completion of our home addition in Ithaca, we can enthusiastically make the same recommendation to others.

Joel & Cathy Z.

Professionalism at every stage of the project – from the initial phone reception, to estimating, to actual construction/renovation.

Hank D.

The measure of an organization is revealed as much when things go wrong (as they do once in awhile) as it is when things go right. My high opinion in Upscale has only increased as has my confidence in Steve Bossard! All is well, here. It is a pleasure to work with such professionals.

Eric & Margaret R.

We are really enjoying our home improvements!

Greta & Luke C.

The overhang/ceiling looks great! We are very pleased.

Mark H.

If you want a top-notch remodeling experience, choose Upscale Remodeling in NY. They will make anything that seems impossible, possible.

Daniel & Debbie G.

The kitchen remodel looks absolutely fabulous! Hardware is great—I can’t wait to put everything away and really start to use that space! Thanks so much for all your hard work and care!

Clare M.

I appreciate the good work you did for us this year.

Ezra C.

He was honest, helpful and skilled in construction. We knew he would succeed in his business because of his basic decency as well as his considerable knowledge of his craft and his clarity in hiring skilled and loyal employees. He has done further work for us over the years. We have much admiration for him.

Enid & Arthur R.

They were courteous, respectful and always communicated in a timely manner. . . . Everyone we dealt with knew their role/craft. We highly recommend them for any size project!

Terri Hoppenrath

The work done is excellent, but it is more than that. Your perspective, direction, and attention to detail has been greatly appreciated, and it shows in the finished product.

Rob and Bettina Arleo

Dan did a great job! Not only was the craftsmanship first rate, but he was a pleasure to work with, was great with the dogs, and always left the work area neat and clean at the end of the day.

Robert O.

I had water coming out of my ceiling from my master bath. I called Upscale and they had someone come out that afternoon and fixed my problem quickly.

Disoski

Once again, Upscale Remodeling in NY did an excellent job on our home. This job had a few pitfalls whereas the last two didn’t but EVERYONE at Upscale was right on top of the problems and the product is SUPER! Thanks again to all! We hope to be able to call on you again soon.

Lisa W.

We've been very happy with the professionalism of Upscale Remodeling in NY. From the beginning of the process to our current point mid-construction they have been very easy to deal with, and have done an excellent job.

David & Ann W.

We are enjoying our new roof and sky lights and will enjoy the flowers as well. Dad's bathroom looks great--he took a shower this morning without help. He's making progress every day and is pretty much on his own. Amazing. Thanks again. Hope you have a wonderful holiday.

Mary R.

Highly recommended, albeit not cheap. Our neighbors are delighted with the remodeling, and comment on it repeatedly.

Jim S. & Carol D.

I just heard another construction nightmare story yesterday and was thanking God for you guys! We still are loving our attic but haven't come up with a better name for it. Hope this gets your day off to a good start. Happy Easter!

Ann & David

It is difficult to describe our pleasure in not only the renovations but in the crew who worked on them. After a while, they seemed like part of the family!

Karen A.

Thanks for a great job!

David C.

CAREERS

Join the Upscale Team

Apply Now
Ready to Remodel Your Career?

Upscale Remodeling is a locally owned business that specializes in mid- to high-end home remodeling. We treat our entire team of employees with respect. Our goal is to select individuals who are the right fit for our team and prioritize their well-being. Our competitive benefits package, coupled with a positive work environment, reflects the effort we’ve invested in creating a workplace culture that prioritizes people above all else.

Open Positions
Carpenter/Remodeler

We are seeking a Carpenter with expertise in all phases of residential remodeling to join a well-established, highly respected remodeling company. This full-time role covers hands-on carpentry and daily jobsite coordination on a variety of custom residential projects in the Ithaca area.

Download Job Description
Apply Now
Architectural Designer

We are seeking an Architectural Designer with a broad set of skills and a desire to participate in all aspects of the design process, from concept design to contract documents.

Download Job Description
Apply Now
Our Mission

To design and build projects of the highest quality, provide our customers with an enjoyable, stress-free, attention-to-every-detail remodeling experience, and do so with a sense of friendliness, fairness, and pride.

Our Core Values
Be humble
Be level-headed
Be people-oriented
Be quality-minded
Do the right thing
Company Culture

We think it’s important to have fun, be honest, and do the right thing. We value creativity and new ideas. Above all, we strive for a culture of excellence and respect.

Perks & Benefits
We offer competitive pay and a fun workplace.

SERVICES

Design-Build Remodeling Services in Ithaca

Whatever you want to remodel, Upscale Remodeling is on standby to help. Regardless of the scope of the project, we’ll treat you with respect, communicate with you every step of the way, and complete your project seamlessly with our adept team of skilled craftsmen and established, trustworthy trade partners.

Kitchen Remodeling
The kitchen is the heart of the house, and a new heart revitalizes the entire home. We meticulously design functional spaces that perfectly blend aesthetics and usability.
Learn More
Bathroom Remodeling
Transform your dated, cramped bathroom into a serene and stylish retreat, or add a new bathroom to handle your family’s evolving needs. We are one of Ithaca's most trusted bath remodeling companies.
Learn More
Basement Renovation & Finishing
Unlock your basement's potential. Whether it's a cozy entertainment area or an extra living space, we'll transform your basement into a functional and inviting extension of your home.
Learn More
Additions & Renovations
Expand and improve your living space with a custom-designed home addition. Our commitment is to seamlessly integrate new spaces that complement your existing home's aesthetics and functionality.
Learn More
Additional Remodeling Services

As Ithaca’s premier design-build remodeler, we provide a wide array of custom home upgrades and renovations, all designed in-house by our talented team. Explore a few of our most popular home remodeling solutions, and if you don’t see what you need, just ask.

Let's Start The Conversation
Whole House Remodels
Transform your entire home to better suit your family’s lifestyle and needs.
Outdoor Spaces
Turn your yard into a personal oasis for entertaining and relaxation.
Porches
Create a welcoming entrance or a cozy retreat with a custom-designed porch.
Mudrooms
Make your home tidier and more welcoming with a stylish mudroom custom-designed for your needs.
Attic Finishing
Maximize your home’s potential by turning your attic into a beautiful living space.
Home Offices
Work happier and be more productive with a custom home office.
Windows & Doors
Experience superior service and quality with our premium window and door installations.
Accessory Dwelling Units
Expand your living space with a custom designed ADU.
INTERIOR DESIGN
Do you offer interior design?

Yes, interior design is part of every Upscale project. Our design team handles selections, finishes, and layouts at our Design Studio in Freeville, so your project’s design and construction run as one integrated design-build process. Interior designer Christie Dixon, a Certified Kitchen and Bath Designer and NKBA Central New York chapter president, leads that work. We don’t offer standalone interior design services.

OUR PROCESS
Transform your vision into reality.

Across hundreds of successful Ithaca remodels, our team prioritizes personalized care. Beginning with attentive listening, we craft home transformations that seamlessly merge beauty, functionality, and a smooth process.

View Our Process
Why Choose Upscale Remodeling for Your Home Transformation

When it comes to your home remodeling project, choosing the right team to deliver residential remodeling services makes all the difference.

At Upscale Remodeling, we bring high-quality craftsmanship and decades of expertise to every renovation, whether you’re updating a single room or embarking on a whole home renovation. As trusted home remodeling contractors serving Ithaca, NY, area since 1991, we specialize in kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling and bathroom updates, basement remodeling, and more, ensuring each space is both beautiful and functional. We also offer exterior remodeling services, helping Ithaca homeowners enhance curb appeal with high-quality materials and design.

Whether you’re looking to add square footage, improve flow, or elevate your living spaces, our remodeling company is committed to delivering high-quality craftsmanship and achieving quality results, no matter the project size. Let’s bring your vision to life—contact us today to start planning your home improvements!

Tailoring a Kitchen Remodel to Your Needs

Many of the kitchens we remodel in the Ithaca area were designed decades ago — built for appliances, workflows, and family sizes that no longer match how people actually cook and live. Opening a wall to connect the kitchen to an adjacent dining room, relocating the sink to face the backyard, or simply replacing a cramped galley layout with an island-centered design can change how your entire home feels. We approach each project by first understanding how you use the space now and how you want to use it going forward — then designing a kitchen that solves for both.

Older homes in the Ithaca and Finger Lakes region present their own set of considerations. Plaster walls, aging plumbing, knob-and-tube wiring, and structural beams in unexpected places are all realities we encounter regularly. We assess these conditions early in the process — before design decisions are locked in — so that the project scope reflects what we actually find behind the walls, not a best-case assumption. That early transparency is one of the clearest advantages of working with a design-build firm: the same team that draws your new kitchen is the team that builds it, which means nothing gets lost between the design intent and the finished result.

The material selection phase is where the project starts to feel real. Our private Design Studio in Freeville gives you access to cabinet door samples, countertop slabs, hardware finishes, tile, and flooring options in one place. Rather than coordinating visits to multiple showrooms on your own, you work through selections in a single environment, with a designer present to evaluate how each choice relates to the others. Decisions that can feel overwhelming — the relationship between cabinet finish, countertop veining, and hardware tone — become clearer when you can see everything side by side.

Once construction begins, our project management process keeps the project on schedule and keeps you informed at each phase. We handle all permitting, subcontractor coordination, and inspections directly. For projects that expand into adjacent spaces — a pantry wall, a laundry area, a breakfast nook opening — we coordinate those scopes in parallel rather than sequentially, which reduces the total time your kitchen is out of commission. Most kitchen remodels we complete in the greater Ithaca area are finished within eight to fourteen weeks from the start of construction, depending on scope.

If you are considering a kitchen remodel — whether it is a focused update or a full reconfiguration — we are happy to schedule an initial consultation at no cost. We will walk through your space, discuss what is realistic within your budget, and give you a clear picture of what the process would look like from start to finish.

Our kitchen designs are led by Christie Dixon, a Certified Kitchen & Bath Designer (CKBD) and president of the NKBA’s Central New York chapter.

We Want to Make Your Dream Bathroom a Reality

Bathrooms in older Ithaca-area homes present a specific set of challenges: tight footprints, inadequate ventilation, single vanities shared by multiple family members, and layouts that made sense in a different era. Most of the bathroom remodels we complete involve more than a cosmetic refresh. We routinely relocate plumbing to free up floor space, add or upgrade exhaust ventilation, and reconfigure layouts to accommodate a double vanity or a walk-in shower where a tub-shower combination used to be. The result is a bathroom that works better for the way you actually use it.

Material selection is where the character of a bathroom takes shape. In our Design Studio in Freeville, you can review tile samples, vanity configurations, countertop materials, and hardware finishes together in one visit — with a designer available to evaluate how each choice interacts with the others. The difference between a bathroom that feels cohesive and one that feels assembled is usually resolved at this stage, not during construction.

Bathrooms also require careful attention to what is happening behind the walls. Moisture intrusion, deteriorated subfloor material, and inadequate waterproofing are common findings once demolition begins — particularly in homes built before 1980. We address these conditions as part of the scope rather than treating them as surprises. Shower surrounds and wet areas are built with a waterproof membrane system, not just cement board, which extends the life of the finished surface considerably.

For primary bathrooms, we often work with homeowners to evaluate whether a modest expansion is worth including in the scope. In many cases, borrowing a few feet from an adjacent closet or hallway allows for a layout change that would otherwise be impossible — and the added cost is modest relative to what it enables. We walk through these options early in the design process so you can make an informed decision before anything is committed to drawings.

Most bathroom remodels we complete in the Ithaca area take between four and eight weeks from the start of construction, depending on scope and whether any structural or plumbing changes are involved. We handle all permitting, subcontractor coordination, and inspections directly. If you are ready to talk through what a bathroom remodel might look like for your home, we are happy to schedule an initial consultation at no cost.

Expanding Your Ithaca Home the Right Way

Adding onto your home is one of the most impactful investments you can make—and in the Ithaca area, it comes with its own set of considerations. From Tompkins County zoning requirements to the unique character of the housing stock in neighborhoods like Cayuga Heights, Fall Creek, and South Hill, a successful addition starts with understanding what’s possible on your specific lot.

Planning and Permits

Most home additions in Tompkins County require a building permit and must meet setback, height, and lot coverage requirements. If your home is in a historic district or near a conservation zone, additional review may apply. We handle the permitting process as part of our design-build approach so you don’t have to navigate it alone.

Common Addition Types

The additions we build most often in the Ithaca area include primary bedroom suites, family room expansions, second-story additions, and mudroom or entryway bump-outs. Many of Ithaca’s older homes—craftsman bungalows, colonials, and mid-century ranches—were built for smaller families and smaller furniture. A well-designed addition can bring the layout in line with how you actually live today.

What Shapes the Cost of a Home Addition

No two additions price the same way, but a few factors drive most of the budget. Footprint and foundation work are the biggest: a bump-out that borrows from an existing roofline costs far less per square foot than a full second-story addition that requires reinforcing the floor structure below. Site access on Ithaca’s hillier lots, the age of your home’s electrical and HVAC systems, and whether the addition includes a kitchen or bathroom—with the plumbing runs that come with them—all move the number. Finish level is the final lever; the same framed space can be finished simply or to a high-design standard. During design we give you a clear, itemized budget before construction begins, so there are no surprises once the work starts.

What to Expect

A typical home addition project takes 4 to 8 months from initial design through construction, depending on scope and complexity. We work with you through every phase—from initial feasibility and architectural drawings to material selection and final walkthrough. Our design-build process keeps design and construction under one roof, which means fewer surprises and a clearer path from concept to completion.

If you’re considering an addition to your home in the greater Ithaca area, we’d welcome the chance to talk through your ideas. Schedule a consultation to see if we’re a good fit for your project.

Every home addition is planned for long-term livability by Christie Dixon, our certified aging-in-place designer.

Basement Remodeling in the Finger Lakes Region

Basements in the Ithaca area come with real advantages—and a few challenges worth planning for. The Finger Lakes climate means moisture management is a priority, and the right approach to waterproofing, insulation, and ventilation makes the difference between a finished basement that feels like a real living space and one that doesn’t.

Moisture and Waterproofing

Many homes in the Ithaca area sit on sloped lots with high water tables or seasonal groundwater. Before any finishing work begins, we assess your basement’s moisture conditions and address drainage, grading, or waterproofing needs. Proper insulation is part of the equation too—it protects your investment and ensures the space stays dry and comfortable year-round.

Egress and Code Requirements

If your basement remodel includes a bedroom, New York building code requires an egress window or door that meets minimum size requirements for emergency exit. We factor this into the design from the start—not as an afterthought—so the layout works both functionally and from a code perspective.

Making the Space Work

The most popular basement projects we handle include home offices, guest suites, entertainment rooms, and exercise spaces. Adding a basement bathroom is another common request that dramatically increases the usability of the space. In homes with lower ceiling heights, we use design techniques—recessed lighting, lighter finishes, strategic layout—to make the space feel open and inviting. Every basement is different, and the design should respond to what you have, not force a generic plan onto it.

ITHACA REMODEL PRICING GUIDES

How Much Will My Remodel Cost?

Our pricing guides are designed to offer rough price ranges based on the hundreds of projects we have completed in and around Ithaca. However, because all our work is custom-designed and tailored to your preferences, these guides are only the first step. Go ahead and explore these guides, then let’s talk about your ideas and vision, and how we can get started making them a reality.

Kitchen Remodel Pricing Guide
Most kitchen remodels we complete in the Ithaca area start at $70,000. Discover detailed insights into kitchen remodeling costs, with our comprehensive pricing guide. Gain insights into estimated expenses for various projects, helping you plan and execute your dream kitchen renovation with confidence.
